name: Resolai – AI Chatbot for Customer Support
author: WP Replai

sections.description:
Resolai is an AI chatbot for customer support on your WordPress site. It adds a chat widget with an AI agent that answers your visitors for you. Tell it about your business, give it a name and a few instructions, and it starts helping visitors in about two minutes.

When a question is too much for the agent, it collects the visitor’s details and emails your team with a summary of the chat. Your visitors always get an answer, and your team only sees the conversations that need a person.

How it works

The agent uses skills to handle common requests. A skill is a short set of instructions, like how to troubleshoot a common issue, how to answer pricing questions or when to email your team. Skills load only when a visitor needs them, which keeps answers focused and AI costs low.

Start with the built in skills, pick from ready made templates or write your own in plain language.

Features

Chat widget

  • Matches your brand color, with your own avatar or a preset icon
  • Welcome message, greeting bubble and quick question buttons
  • Dictation, so visitors can speak instead of typing. The text lands in the message box to check before sending
  • Shows which pages and PDFs the agent read to answer
  • Keeps a visitor’s unsent message when they refresh or change pages
  • Visitors can read their past conversations
  • Visitors can rate each chat
  • Optional consent step that links to your privacy policy

AI agent

  • Searches your own pages, posts and other content to find answers
  • Reads web pages and PDFs that visitors share in the chat
  • Hands off to your team by email when it can’t help
  • Pick any OpenRouter model that can use tools, with prices shown and the best ones recommended
  • Test chat in your dashboard before you go live

Dashboard and conversations

  • Conversations, ratings, usage and AI cost at a glance
  • Search and filter conversations by status
  • Every conversation gets a title, its language and an AI summary
  • Full transcripts that show which skills and tools the agent used

Privacy

  • Conversations are stored in your own WordPress database
  • Delete conversations one by one, in bulk or automatically after a set time
  • No credit link on your site unless you turn it on

You need an OpenRouter API key

Resolai uses OpenRouter to get its AI replies. You add your own API key during setup and pay OpenRouter directly for what you use. There is no markup and no subscription to Resolai. Most conversations cost a fraction of a cent.

Premium

Premium is a separate, optional plugin sold on wpreplai.com. It adds proactive nudges that start the conversation, a WooCommerce skill, EU data routing, custom and translatable widget text, more skill templates and an email step before the chat starts. Resolai works fully without it.

Resolai is made by the team at wpreplai.com.

Other Products

Also check out our other WordPress products.

  • BerqWP – All-in-One WordPress performance plugin.
  • ElizaWP – SEO MCP for AI agents that researches, writes and publishes for WordPress.
  • CanvoWP – Completely free Agent-first website builder plugin. No blocks, no bloat.
  • Berq Markdown – Automatically generate markdown version of web pages for AI agents.
  • Berq Used CSS – Remove unused CSS automatically.
  • Camouflage Security – Static WordPress Firewall and PHP Isolation.
  • Barlapse – Fix admin bar overflow issue in WordPress admin panel.
  • Seenli Blocks – Conditional display blocks for logged in users & user roles.

External services

Resolai connects to the services below. No conversation data is sent until you add an OpenRouter API key.

OpenRouter

OpenRouter provides the AI models that write the agent’s replies.

  • When a visitor sends a message, the conversation so far, your agent’s instructions, your business details and any skills the agent loads are sent to OpenRouter to get a reply.
  • After a conversation starts, it is sent once more to write its title, detect its language and write a summary for your dashboard.
  • When you add your API key, it is checked with OpenRouter.
  • The dashboard asks OpenRouter how much credit is left on your key.
  • If you turn on Dictation, a visitor’s voice recording is sent to OpenRouter in short pieces to turn it into text. Nothing is recorded until the visitor taps the mic.
  • The Settings screen loads OpenRouter’s public list of models and prices, once a day.

OpenRouter terms of service and privacy policy.

Web pages and PDFs

When a visitor shares a link, or a skill points to a page, the agent can open that web page or PDF to answer. The request goes straight to that address. Only the address is requested, no visitor data is sent with it.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins, Add New Plugin and search for Resolai.
  2. Install and activate it. The setup opens automatically.
  3. Add your OpenRouter API key, tell the agent about your business and choose its name and look.
  4. Try the test chat, then switch the widget on. It appears on every page of your site.
sections.faq:
Is Resolai free?

Yes. The plugin is free and fully working. You only pay OpenRouter for the AI usage on your own account.

How much does the AI cost?

It depends on the model you choose and how long the conversations are. Most conversations cost a fraction of a cent. The dashboard shows your cost per conversation and the credit left on your OpenRouter key.

Which AI models can I use?

Any model on OpenRouter that can use tools, from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Meta and many more. Settings shows each model’s price and marks a few we recommend. You can switch models at any time.

Can visitors speak instead of typing?

Yes. Turn on Dictation in Settings, Chat widget. A mic button appears in the chat, and what the visitor says lands in the message box so they can check it before sending. On a computer they can also hold Space in the empty message box. Browsers only allow the microphone on sites that use https. Dictation works in many languages and uses your OpenRouter credits.

Can visitors talk to a person?

Yes. When the agent can’t help, it asks for the visitor’s email and sends your team the request with a summary of the conversation.

Where are conversations stored?

In your own WordPress database. They never leave your site except when they are sent to OpenRouter to write a reply, a title or a summary.

Can I ask visitors for consent first?

Yes. Turn on Require consent in Settings, Privacy and data. Visitors then agree to your privacy policy before they can chat.

Does the agent speak other languages?

Yes. It replies in the language the visitor writes in, and the dashboard shows the language of each conversation.

How do I change the look of the widget?

Pick your brand color and avatar in Settings, Chat widget. For anything more, add your own styles in Appearance, Customize, Additional CSS, or in the Styles panel of the Site Editor. The widget sits inside #wpreplai-root.

Will it slow down my site?

The widget loads a small script and stylesheet at the bottom of the page, without any third party scripts. AI replies are fetched only when a visitor sends a message.

What does Premium add?

Proactive nudges that start the conversation, a WooCommerce skill with product, cart and order cards, EU data routing, custom and translatable widget text, more skill templates and an email step before the chat starts. Premium is a separate plugin from wpreplai.com. The free plugin never installs it for you.
sections.changelog:
1.3.12

  • Plugin files always load fresh after an update, so the chat widget and admin screens never show an older version

1.3.11

  • Dictation: visitors can speak instead of typing. Text appears while they talk and lands in the message box, so they can check it before sending. Off by default, with a recording limit you choose
  • Hold Space in the empty message box to dictate on a computer
  • Pick the dictation model in Settings. Multilingual Whisper models are recommended
  • New AI model picker in setup and Settings, with search, prices from OpenRouter, recommended models and a filter for free models. Setup picks DeepSeek V4.1 Flash by default
  • Under each reply, visitors can see which pages and PDFs the agent read to answer it
  • A visitor’s unsent message is kept when they refresh or move to another page
  • Skills made from a template show an Update button when the template gets new tools
  • Once your agent has answered 10 chats in a month, the Dashboard asks for a review on WordPress.org. Maybe later asks again in two weeks, and the request stays until you say you left one
  • An admin notice asks you to update WP Replai Pro when it is older than this version needs. After an automatic update, the site admin also gets one email
  • The chat scrolls to the start of a new reply instead of the end
  • “Looking into it” shows while a reply takes a moment
  • Every text in the chat widget can be translated, including the labels for screen readers
  • Visitors see a friendly message when a reply fails, instead of a technical error. Admins still see the details
  • Buttons in the admin show a spinner while they work
  • New design for the Premium tab in Settings
  • Setup step 1 lists what Free and Premium include today, with a link to compare them
  • The agent no longer uses em dashes in its replies
  • Settings explains why the mic is hidden on sites without https
  • Theme styles no longer stretch or misalign buttons in the chat widget

1.2.14

  • New dashboard page with conversations, tickets, handoffs, average rating and tickets resolved by the AI agent
  • The dashboard also shows your AI cost and token usage
  • The conversation list now shows each chat’s title, status, language, number of messages, rating and total cost
  • New conversation page with the full chat, an AI summary and the page where the chat started
  • Change a conversation’s status and export its transcript
  • Choose a preset icon for your agent’s avatar
  • Add common questions that the chat suggests to visitors
  • Data retention deletes old conversations automatically after the number of days you choose
  • Visitors can read their past conversations in the chat widget
  • The “Powered by” credit link is now off by default and can be turned on in Settings
  • Removed the custom CSS setting. Use Additional CSS in the Customizer instead
  • Premium is now a separate plugin that you download from your wpreplai.com account and install yourself. It adds editable widget text and a visitor email step

1.2.13

  • New design for setup, the dashboard, conversations, skills, settings and the chat widget
  • Conversation status, titles, language detection and AI summaries
  • Usage and cost tracking per conversation
  • Data retention settings
